blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein milega.

items: Hypothesis kya hai? (a) aakhri nateeja (b) test ki qeemat (c) tajweez ki hui wazahat (proposed explanation) (d) dataset
Null hypothesis kis cheez ko dikhata hai? (a) mutabadil khayal (b) koi asar ya farq nahi (c) aakhri nateeja (d) prediction model
Null hypothesis ki alamat kya hai? (a) H₁ (b) H₂ (c) H₀ (d) Hₓ
p-value kis kaam aati hai? (a) durusti napna (b) hypothesis test karna (c) variance napna (d) data store karna
Agar p-value < α ho to faisla kya hai? (a) H₀ accept (b) H₀ reject (c) data nazar-andaz (d) mean dobara nikalna
Critical region kya hai? (a) mehfooz hissa (b) rejection area (radd hone ka hissa) (c) data ki range (d) sample space
Test statistic ki misaal kaunsi hai? (a) mean (b) t-value (c) mode (d) median
Data visualisation kis liye hai? (a) data store karna (b) nataij wazeh pesh karna (c) data delete karna (d) mean nikalna
Muqable (comparison) ke liye kaunsa chart mufeed hai? (a) pie chart (b) bar chart (c) table (d) text
Data mein bias ka matlab: (a) durust data (b) mutawazin data (c) na-munsifana numaindagi (d) random data

blocks.text: Kitab MCQ 3 aur 5 mein alamatein typesetting code ki shakal mein chhapti hai: (H_1), (H_2), (H_0), (H_x). In ka matlab H₁, H₂, H₀ aur Hₓ hai.

Hypothesis testing ka concept aur data analysis mein is ka kirdar samjhaiye. (jawab: 7.1)
Hypotheses ki mukhtalif qismein bataiye aur samjhaiye ke durust hypotheses kaise banate hain. (jawab: 7.2)
Hypothesis testing ke aham concepts samjhaiye: test statistics, critical region aur p-value. (jawab: 7.3)
Hypothesis testing ke qadam ek munasib misaal ke saath bataiye. (jawab: 7.4)
Hypothesis testing mein data visualization ki ahmiyat aur graphs ka kirdar samjhaiye. (jawab: 7.5)
Data science ke akhlaqi masail par baat karein: bias, data ka akhlaqi istemal aur zimmedarana communication. (jawab: 7.6)
Hypothesis testing ke nataij ki tashreeh aur nateejon ko hypotheses se jorna samjhaiye. (jawab: 7.7)
Data analysis mein nataij wazeh tareeqe se kaise batane chahiye aur yeh kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 7.7)
